design.commonWindowStart: first V2 out-of-sample origin plus 57 calendar days
design.target: fill × (signed actual FMM−DA minus 1 USD/MWh); unfilled actions have zero payoff
design.quotes: INC=causal V2 predicted DA−10; DEC=causal V2 predicted DA+10
design.decisionRule: At each node/hour choose the higher estimated net-payoff side; require strictly >1 USD/MWh, then rank by estimated net payoff.
design.allocation: Same 1-MWh minimum admission and weighted residual allocation as the existing simulator, replacing z score by predicted net payoff. No actual target-day prices enter planning.
design.preprocessing: Median imputation and Ridge scaling fitted on each chronological training window only; no random CV or early-stopping validation.
design.feeSensitivity: Freeze orders using training fee=1; fees 0/1/2/5 only revalue identical orders, never select a winner.
design.postOutcomeDiagnostic: Eight fixed DA/spread/sigma V1/V2 hybrids on old Oct15–28; exact three-factor Shapley, not a new candidate search.
design.defaultComparison: All fixed policies displayed in declared order; no profit-maximizing model selection.
design.priorKnowledge: V1/V2 outcomes, including Oct15–28 and V2 monthly results, were already inspected.
design.forward: No V3 future forecast or pre-cutoff plan is generated; the Oct30 cutoff has passed. V2 archived forecast remains separate.

inputAttribution.note: 结果后机制诊断；三项交互按所有加入顺序平均分摊。它不是未来因果效应，也未用于选择模型或策略。

forward.reason: V3 设计与运行晚于 Oct30 PT 研究截点；Oct31 所需 Oct29 完整日价格尚不在档案。本轮不生成 V3 前向预测，也不改写 V2 已事前归档批次。

reasons: 全部历史结果已用于开发；没有新的独立未见测试。
模拟成交及费用假设不等于完整结算和真实成交。
任何盈利候选仍需新的事前归档验证。

warnings: V3 预测的是固定报价下每提交 MWh 的扣费收益，不能当作 FMM−DA 电价预测或获利概率。
每个目标日只用 D−2 及更早的 56 日历史样本外 V2 预测及已发生价格；基本面也只取 D−2 或更早。
基本面是本次下载的 ACTUAL 历史，可能含修订；它不是历史时点原始发布版本。
训练费用固定 $1/MWh，决策缓冲固定 $1/MWh，均为研究假设；费用切换不改变订单。
不交易参照没有风险暴露，不能被称为预测赢家。
资金限制仅为 12 MWh/日及节点/单格电量约束，不包含信用、资金和官方申报资格校验。
